finalText:
**Big: 1291 hits across 94 files.**

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` | 1200 | rename |
| `migrations/` | 61 | freeze |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | freeze |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | freeze |
| `lib/` | 5 | split |

`vendor/reporting-sdk` is regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. Edits get wiped.

`migrations/` is applied history. Add a new `ALTER TABLE` migration instead. 125 SQL lines name the live column.

`docs/openapi.yaml` is the public contract. So is the right side of `WIRE`, [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8).

Next: sign off on `services/**` only.
